tasks.title: Implement auto-fix loop, escalation, and SSE events
tasks.description: In `runPipelineReviewStage`, after self-check round (R1) and reading review.md: parse verdict. If PASS, return as-is. If FAIL and checkpoint has `no-auto-fix`, skip to awaiting-user. Otherwise enter auto-fix loop (max 2 attempts): emit `plan_round_start` with roundType `auto-fix`/`re-verify`, call conn.prompt with auto-fix then re-verify prompts, parse verdict after re-verify. On PASS: add issue comment via commentRepo, return awaiting-user. On exhaustion: write `no-auto-fix` checkpoint, return `StageResult { escalateToStage: Stage.Build }`. In `run()` loop Review case: if reviewResult has escalateToStage, transition issue to that stage and break (continue loop) instead of setting approval state. Wire commentRepo in `agent-runner-service.ts` WorkflowController construction.
acceptanceCriteria: After R1 self-check, review.md is parsed for Verdict PASS/FAIL
Verdict PASS returns requiresApproval:true without auto-fix loop
Verdict FAIL with no-auto-fix checkpoint skips auto-fix, returns awaiting-user
Verdict FAIL without checkpoint enters auto-fix loop (max 2 attempts)
Each auto-fix round emits plan_round_start with roundType 'auto-fix'
Each re-verify round emits plan_round_start with roundType 're-verify'
plan_session_update events use correct roundType for auto-fix/re-verify rounds
Successful auto-fix adds comment to issue via commentRepo
Failed auto-fix (2 attempts exhausted) writes no-auto-fix checkpoint and returns escalateToStage: Stage.Build
run() loop Review case handles escalateToStage: transitions to Build stage and continues loop
commentRepo is passed when constructing WorkflowController in agent-runner-service.ts
conn.close() is called in all exit paths (success, failure, catch)
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Import buildAutoFixPrompt and buildReVerifyPrompt from artifact-prompt.ts. Reuse existing emitSafe helper for SSE events. Round index: R2=2 (auto-fix attempt 1), R3=3 (re-verify attempt 1), R4=4 (auto-fix attempt 2), R5=5 (re-verify attempt 2).
